# `/user-apps` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### PATCH /user-apps/v1/{id}

`patchUserAppV1` — Patch user app by id — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API updates an existing user app using [JSON Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) syntax. The following fields are patchable: **account**

- Scopes: idn:app-roles:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the user app to patch
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: userapp

### GET /user-apps/v1/{id}/available-accounts

`listAvailableAccountsForUserAppV1` — List available accounts for user app — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the list of available accounts for the specified user app. The user app needs to belong lo logged in user.

- Scopes: idn:app-roles:manage, idn:app-roles:read
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the user app
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.

- Returns 200: array of appaccountdetails

### GET /user-apps/v1

`listOwnedUserAppsV1` — List owned user apps — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the list of user apps assigned to logged in user

- Scopes: idn:app-roles:manage, idn:app-roles:read
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.

  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq; ownerName: eq, sw; ownerAlias: eq, sw; accountId: eq; sourceAppId: eq — e.g. `name eq "user app name"`
- Returns 200: array of userapp
